verdict.rationale: Graphite ships a CLI, but the evidence describes it as a stacking and git-workflow tool. Its AI reviews run automatically on pull requests through the GitHub App. Nothing in the pack shows running reviews from the CLI against local diffs or in CI scripts, or emitting machine-readable review output, so the CLI is only an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As a developer, I run reviews from a CLI against local diffs or in CI scripts, with machine-readable output my tooling can consume
